# [TEST] E2E-12 — Build a real-time collaborative whiteboard app with WebSocket sync

Create a multi-user collaborative whiteboard application. Requirements: Canvas-based drawing with brush/eraser tools, real-time sync via WebSockets, user presence indicators, undo/redo stack per user, room-based sessions with shareable links, conflict resolution for simultaneous edits, offline support with sync-on-reconnect, and a Node.js backend with Redis pub/sub for scaling. This is architecturally complex — needs careful design before coding.
